actions.clone_report.description: Creates a copy of a Power BI report, optionally into a different workspace or bound to a different dataset.
actions.clone_report.props.new_report_na: The name to give the cloned report.
actions.clone_report.props.report_id.des: Select a report from the chosen workspace.
actions.clone_report.props.target_datase: Optional. The ID of the dataset the cloned report should bind to (found in the dataset's Power BI portal URL, e.g. ".../datasets/{this-id}/details"). Leave blank to keep the source report's dataset.
actions.clone_report.props.target_worksp: Where to place the cloned report. Defaults to the same workspace as the source report.
The Power BI workspace to use. Defaults to "My workspace" (your personal workspace).
actions.create_dataset.description: Create a new dataset in Power BI with custom schema (Push, Streaming, or PushStreaming mode).
actions.create_dataset.props.dataset_nam: Name of the dataset to create
actions.create_dataset.props.tables.desc: Define the tables and their columns for the dataset (JSON format)
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.export_report_to_file.descriptio: Exports a Power BI report to a PDF, PPTX, or PNG file.
actions.export_report_to_file.props.file: The format to export the report to.
actions.export_report_to_file.props.max_: How long to keep polling for the export to finish before giving up.
actions.export_report_to_file.props.repo: Select a report from the chosen workspace.
actions.export_report_to_file.props.work: The Power BI workspace to use. Defaults to "My workspace" (your personal workspace).
actions.import_pbix.description: Uploads a Power BI Desktop (.pbix), Excel (.xlsx), or RDL file into a workspace, creating a new dataset and report.
actions.import_pbix.props.dataset_displa: The display name for the imported dataset, including its file extension (e.g. "MyReport.pbix"). Defaults to the uploaded file's name.
actions.import_pbix.props.max_wait_secon: How long to keep polling for the import to finish before returning its current status.
What to do if a dataset with the same name already exists in the workspace.
Replace, or create if none exists (CreateOrOverwrite)
actions.import_pbix.props.skip_report.de: Only import the dataset, skipping the report. Only applies to .pbix files.
actions.import_pbix.props.workspace_id.d: The Power BI workspace to use. Defaults to "My workspace" (your personal workspace).
actions.list_reports.description: Lists all reports in a Power BI workspace.
The Power BI workspace to use. Defaults to "My workspace" (your personal workspace).
actions.push_rows_to_dataset_table.descr: Add rows to a table in a Power BI dataset (supports Push, Streaming, and PushStreaming modes)
actions.push_rows_to_dataset_table.props: JSON object containing the rows to add to the table. Each row must match your table schema.
Skip refreshing the dataset after pushing data (only applies to Push and PushStreaming modes)
actions.refresh_dataset.description: Triggers a refresh of a Power BI dataset so its data reflects the latest changes from the underlying source.
actions.refresh_dataset.props.dataset_id: Select a dataset from the chosen workspace.
actions.refresh_dataset.props.notify_opt: When to send a mail notification about the refresh outcome.
actions.refresh_dataset.props.workspace_: The Power BI workspace to use. Defaults to "My workspace" (your personal workspace).
actions.run_dax_query.description: Executes a DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) query against a Power BI dataset and returns the resulting rows.
actions.run_dax_query.props.dataset_id.d: Select a dataset from the chosen workspace.
actions.run_dax_query.props.dax_query.de: The DAX query to run, e.g. "EVALUATE VALUES(MyTable)" or "EVALUATE TOPN(10, MyTable)". Only DAX is supported (no MDX/DMV).
actions.run_dax_query.props.impersonated: Optional. The user principal name (e.g. "jane@contoso.com") to impersonate for row-level security. Ignored if the dataset has no RLS roles.
actions.run_dax_query.props.include_null: Whether blank/null values should be included in the result rows.
actions.run_dax_query.props.workspace_id: The Power BI workspace to use. Defaults to "My workspace" (your personal workspace).
auth.description:
If you'd like to use your own custom Azure app instead of the default app, follow the [Azure app creation guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/quickstart-register-app#register-an-application),
 set the **Redirect URI** to {{redirectUrl}} and add the following **Power BI Service (Delegated) permissions** under **API permissions**:
 - Dataset.ReadWrite.All
 - Report.ReadWrite.All
 - Content.Create
 - Workspace.Read.All
 - offline_access
description: Create and manage Power BI datasets and reports, and push data to them
